text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired: HIGH - gpu-node-57 (rack-e7-host3)
Severity: P1
Trigger: node-heartbeat-missed, kubelet=NotReady
Affected: gpu-node-57 (10.10.7.33)
Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/node-notready
Pager: @oncall (rotation: alex)

pagerduty: Incident created: PD-94821 - gpu-node-57 unreachable

alex: acked. I'm on call and taking this. grabbing serial console now. pinging SRE and infra on call.

oncall-bot: alex acknowledged the incident at 15:01:12

maya: on-call SRE here, jumping in. can we get serial console logs? also what's the BMC status?

alex: attaching to BMC serial (ipmi -> serial-over-lan). Output shows repeated panics. pasting tail:
```
[ 1234.567890] Kernel panic - not syncing: nvlink: fatal error in nvlink driver
[ 1234.568000] Call Trace:
[ 1234.568100] dump_stack+0x45/0x6b
[ 1234.568200] panic+0x1c0/0x3e0
[ 1234.568300] nvlink_error_handler+0x14f/0x1a0
[ 1234.568400] ``(more repeated)``
[ 1234.569000] ---[ end trace 1234567890abcdef ]---
```

eli: looks like NVMe and NVLink errors in the kernel log. we should cordon and drain the node to avoid spreading OOM/evictions for critical workloads. I'll run the kubectl commands if alex signs off.

alex: go for it. cordon first to prevent scheduling:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-57
# node/gpu-node-57 cordoned
```

alex: starting drain for non-critical pods. holding on draining pods labeled "inference-critical=true" until we have a fallback. customer telemetry shows tenant-acme error spike.

cust-signal-bot: [ALERT] tenant-acme: 503 spike: baseline 1.2% -> 18% in last 2m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Impact: degraded customer latency and errors.

maya: we should route critical traffic to fallback pool (gpu-fallback-1). sam, can you flip routing policy?

sam: yep. updating routing policy now. will redirect tenant-acme and other critical tenants to gpu-fallback-1 via the routing service. give me 30s.

sam: routing change applied. traffic dumping to fallback pool. please monitor for correctness.

alex: drain in progress. left behind pods: inference-critical=true (2 pods) - will keep them until we confirm fallback healthy. attaching checkpoint for in-flight jobs for tenant-acme. created checkpoint ID cp-20231010-2167.

pagerduty: escalation: incident escalated to SRE-Lead and infra-eng per policy (after 2mins unacked).

eli: serial shows NVMe I/O errors before panic: 
```
[   987.123456] nvme nvme0: I/O 0x1234cd error status: I/O timeout
[   987.123460] nvme nvme0: aborting command 0x1234cd
```
I recommend a soft-reboot via BMC. if that fails, do power-cycle. RMA may be required.

alex: snapshots/backup for local volumes? I kicked off volume snapshot for pods with local state. ticket INF-6321 created to track storage snapshot + RMA actions.

maya: performing soft-reboot via BMC now. manual note: if kubelet doesn't come up in 3m we'll hard power-cycle. Notifying customer ops and support.

oncall-bot: BMC soft-reboot initiated at 15:05:40

alex: node is powering cycle, console shows kernel boot beginning. kubelet is starting but may fail if NVMe still flaky.

eli: monitoring node registration. once kubelet is Ready we'll start letting non-critical pods back. if NVMe errors persist we'll mark host for RMA.

oncall-bot: kubelet status change: NotReady -> Ready at 15:09:21

alex: kubelet Ready. re-schedule checks running. metrics show pod restarts for some GPU DaemonSet components; re-creating device plugin pods.

cust-signal-bot: tenant-acme errors returning to baseline. 503 rate back to 1.5% and latency normalized.

maya: mitigated for now. creating follow-up postmortem. immediate next steps:
- schedule RCA with storage eng for NVMe error pattern
- hardware shop to run diagnostics and likely RMA for host (rack-e7-host3)
- improve alert thresholds for NVMe error + kernel panic correlation
- add automated route to fallback earlier in runbook

eli: taking handoff for post-incident tasks and coordinating RMA. created INF-6322 for hardware RMA and INF-6323 for storage investigation.

alex: leaving runbook updates and ops notes in PD incident and INF tickets. passing to next on-call: eli.

maya: thanks all — marking this thread resolved for active mitigation. will publish postmortem draft in #postmortems tomorrow and cc infra/storage. :thumbsup:

eli: acknowledged handoff, will follow up with owners. :+1:
